localEvidence: All Live route identifiers render in the enterprise shell through a direct deep link.
Exactly 15 primary Live destinations are exposed in enterprise navigation.
Consolidated, removed, Preview, Labs, and unknown links receive explicit handling.
Live Command Center and Work Orders expose no demo entry point.
No page errors or unexpected request failures were observed by the local smoke harness.
limitations: The shell harness does not use production Clerk or authoritative production Convex data.
The tolerated offline /gateway/status probe is not evidence of a healthy deployed orchestration service.
Only four critical routes and one dialog have axe evidence; only the Work Orders-to-Tasks shell flow has mobile evidence.
Production actions, persistence, refresh, back/forward, negative permissions, and route-specific loading, empty, error, and degraded states remain externally blocked.
